title: JBCクラシックの後に・浮かれ気分で？

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for your support today, everyone!
Woooooo!
The winning concert has a much bigger crowd than usual. The venue has never been this lively.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Phew… I'm sizzling.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: My whole body is still toasty.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: They sure were!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'd like to think I contributed… at least a little.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But the next race is gonna be even better! ♪
choice_data_list: I want to see you on the greatest stage there is.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Meaaaning…
choice_data_list: How about tackling the Tokyo Daishoten?
How about tackling the Tokyo Daishoten?

text_block_list.text: The Tokyo Daishoten is the final G1 race of the year, taking place right after the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh! What a way to wrap up the year!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I feel like I've seen it a bunch on TV before.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Wait! That means it's a broadcast race! Are you telling me this Umadol is gonna be on TV?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We can't let this opportunity go to waste! Let's enter the Tokyo Daishoten!
We set our sights on the Tokyo Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's finally time… I'm heading for the top stage in all of dirt racing! ☆
On our way back from the racetrack…

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: Hey, erm… You're that Umadol, Falco, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Mhm! ☆ The one and only! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: Wow, awesome! I actually found out about you just recently…

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: See, one of my fellow idol fans told me all about you. They said that there's an "Umadol" who goes super hard!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: I've watched all of your videos on UmaTube! They were so good!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy you liked them! ☆ Thanks a lot! ♪
Smart Falcon's performances appeal to more than just racing fans, it seems. Her fanbase is steadily growing…

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: When is your next performance? I haven't seen you live yet, and I'd love to come watch!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm going to be competing in the Tokyo Daishoten next! Don't miss it!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: The Tokyo… Daishoten?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the Tokyo Daishoten! It's the last race of the year!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: Oh. I thought the last race was the Arima Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Um…

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: I got it! I'll look it up and come watch! Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, please do! ☆ Thank youuu! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Umm… This might be a strange thing to ask, but…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Dirt races are in right now, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: No particular reason! I was just, you know, curious…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Actually, just forget it! It's nothing, really!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right! I have a favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Can we go watch the Arima Kinen? We can, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's a household name—the top stage of the turf! I could learn a lot by going there myself.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I wanna study it for my Tokyo Daishoten performance. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Come on! Pretty please?
Her overly cheerful demeanor makes me a little uneasy, but I can't argue that we could learn something from such a big race.
choice_data_list: Okay, let's go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yaay! ☆ It's a promise. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay, Trainer! Nighty niiight! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I hope you have a lovely dream about me! ♪
And so, we decide to watch the Arima Kinen before we take on the Tokyo Daishoten.
